periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the eye patches are oriented at an oblique angle of approximately 75 degrees relative to the horizontal inter-ocular axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly oval morphology with an estimated height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.8:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering toward the inferior-lateral margin of the orbital patches.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brownish-yellow staining of the white ventral fur across the abdominal and inguinal regions.
